newsitem.title: UK: British Vita shares gain after results.
newsitem.headline: British Vita shares gain after results.

text.p: Shares in chemicals company British Vita Plc gained on Monday after the company edged up profits and paid out a higher dividend, traders said.
Shares were up 12 pence by 1406 GMT to 222, just below the high of 223.
Pretax profits for the year ending December 31, 1996 inched up to 55.5 million stg from 55.3 million stg previously and the company paid a total dividend of 8.25 pence, up from 7.95 pence.
Traders said a company meeting with analysts had been positive and added support to the share rise.
"It was an optimistic meeting and confirmed everything was going fine," one trader said.
